name: UpsellPress – Sales Booster
author: Digital Web Tutor

sections.description:
UpsellPress is a lightweight and powerful tool designed to help you increase your average order value and conversion rate. With a focus on simplicity and performance, it allows you to create and display custom upsell offers anywhere on your site.

Whether you’re running a WooCommerce store or a simple blog, UpsellPress gives you the tools to recommend products, services, or premium content to your visitors at the right moment.

Key Features:

  • Easy Setup: Get your first upsell offer live in minutes.
  • Customizable Design: Match the look and feel of your brand with easy color and text options.
  • Automatic Display: Automatically show offers at the end of posts or pages.
  • Shortcode Support: Use the [upsellpress] shortcode to place offers exactly where you want them.
  • Performance Optimized: Clean code ensures no impact on your site’s loading speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the upsellpress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to UpsellPress in the WordPress admin menu to configure your offer.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! While it works on any WordPress post or page, it’s a great companion for WooCommerce stores.

Can I customize the colors?

Absolutely. You can change the background color and button text through the settings page.

  • Initial release. Basic upsell functionality and settings page.
